title: The Throne Room in Heaven
intro: John is caught up to heaven and sees God's throne surrounded by worship. Chapters 4-5 are the great turning point in Revelation - from the churches on earth to the heavenly control room where the course of history is directed.

items.title: The Throne and the One Sitting on It
The Rainbow Around the Throne
items.note: The rainbow reminds us of God's covenant faithfulness (Gen 9)

items.title: The 24 Elders
items.note: Likely representing the redeemed from both the Old and New Testaments

items.title: The Four Living Creatures
items.note: The same creatures as in Ezekiel (Ezek 1)

items.title: "Worthy are you, our Lord and God"

footer.title: Worship in Heaven
footer.content: Revelation 4-5 shows that the center of the universe is God's throne - and that the most important activity in heaven is worship. Chapter 5 continues with the Lamb who is worthy to open the scroll with its seven seals.
